concepts.headline: What could your address earn nightly?
concepts.body: A local short-term rental can pull a real nightly rate. We model the typical range for your market before you commit a dollar.
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead flat-lay of brass keys, a city map, and a coffee cup on warm oak

concepts.headline: The number your spare lease leaves behind.
concepts.body: An empty unit earns nothing while the lease runs. We estimate the typical monthly range a furnished STR could return instead.
concepts.visual_direction: Sunlit empty living room, bare floor, soft shadows from tall windows

concepts.headline: Curious what this market actually rents for?
concepts.body: Occupancy and nightly rates vary by block. We pull comparable listings and give you an honest estimated range, not a single hero number.
concepts.visual_direction: Close crop of a furnished bedside table at dusk, lamp glow, linen bedding

concepts.headline: You own it. We run it.
concepts.body: You fund the unit and sign the lease. We handle setup, guests, cleaning, and the day-to-day so it stays hands-off.
concepts.visual_direction: Styled short-term rental living room at golden hour, keys resting on a clean console table, no people

concepts.headline: An asset, not a second job.
concepts.body: This is a real short-term rental you fund and control. We operate it end to end, so it does not become work for you.
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead flat-lay of a tidy property binder, coffee, and a single brass key on a marble surface, no people

concepts.headline: Done-for-you, from lease to payout.
concepts.body: We manage the listing, the turnovers, and the guests on a flat monthly fee, no revenue share [PENDING-D01]. Typical setup runs a few weeks, an estimate that varies by market.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial close-up of a made-up guest bed with crisp linens and soft window light, no people

concepts.headline: You don't need to own it to run it
concepts.body: You fund the deal, you sign the lease, we run the property. Ownership was never the requirement.
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead editorial shot of a styled rental living room, warm window light, no people

concepts.headline: The deed is not the deal
concepts.body: Lease the right unit and operate it as a short-term rental. Estimated returns vary by market and unit, typical of a managed arbitrage setup with a flat monthly fee, no revenue share.
concepts.visual_direction: Close-up of brass keys resting on a clean stone counter beside a folded linen towel, soft daylight

concepts.headline: Skip the mortgage. Keep the operation.
concepts.body: No purchase, no property tax, no thirty-year loan. You hold the lease, we handle guests, turnovers, and pricing.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial flat lay of a signed lease document, fountain pen, and coffee cup on a walnut desk, morning light

concepts.headline: You fund it. You sign the lease. We run it.
concepts.body: That is the whole model. No revenue share, no hidden cut, just a flat monthly fee of [PENDING-D01].
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead editorial shot of a signed lease, a set of keys, and a bank statement on a clean walnut desk in soft daylight

concepts.headline: Most months land in a range, not a promise
concepts.body: Typical net returns fall within an estimated range, and we show you the math before you commit a dollar. Some months run low.
concepts.visual_direction: Close-up of a printed spreadsheet with a range of figures highlighted, beside a black coffee on a marble surface

concepts.headline: Here is what we will not tell you
concepts.body: No invented countdowns, no single hero number, no hype. Just the model, the estimated ranges, and the risks in writing.
concepts.visual_direction: A single document on a linen surface under window light, one corner gently lifted, muted editorial tones

concepts.headline: When the slot is gone, it's gone.
concepts.body: We cap how many properties we take on so each one is run right. Real availability this month, no waitlist theater. Flat monthly fee, no revenue share [PENDING-D01].
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial close-up of a single furnished living room photographed through an open doorway, warm late-afternoon light

concepts.headline: We run a few. Not everyone.
concepts.body: Capacity is the constraint, not demand. If a spot is open in your area this month, you fund and lease the unit and we operate it end to end. Typical returns quoted as a range, never a single promise.
concepts.visual_direction: Minimal editorial flat-lay of a city map, lease folder, and a coffee cup on a dark walnut desk

concepts.headline: We learned on 100+ units. Not yours.
concepts.body: Most operators practice on your money. We already ran the playbook across 100-plus units before you signed a lease. You get the version that survived.
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead flat-lay of a worn leather-bound operations binder, tabbed dividers, and a brass key on a dark walnut desk, warm window light

concepts.headline: A hundred units of mistakes. Already made.
concepts.body: Every pricing miss, bad cleaner, and slow turnover happened on our units, not yours. You fund it, you sign the lease, we run it with what those units taught us.
concepts.visual_direction: Close-up of a city wall map with clustered pins marking many managed properties, soft directional desk lamp glow

concepts.headline: Operators, not a course. 100+ doors run.
concepts.body: We don't sell you a how-to. We run the units ourselves, 100-plus of them, and report estimated typical returns as a range so you know what you actually fund.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial still life of a tablet showing a clean occupancy dashboard beside a stacked set of unit keys, muted morning light
